recommendation: Keep the commit as-is. It completes the applied CQI clarification without changing operation parameters or behavior, and it removes contradictory conformance text from both the current $evaluate operation and the retained retired $evaluate-measure artifact.
issue_request: FHIR-51487 was Applied/Persuasive for R6 and requested replacing the Measure $evaluate return parameter description with Bundle-per-input-subject wording, explicit 1..* MeasureReport resources, a link to Bundle-organization guidance, and a note that the 0..* return parameter is returned using a Parameters resource. A Jira comment also requested applying the same clarification to the overall operation description.
initial_application: The Jira-linked PR #3932 commit 9aafebcbaf1bf483be501112cc5fdca132848446 added the guidance link and Parameters-response note to source/measure/operationdefinition-Measure-evaluate.xml. It did not fully replace the return wording with the requested SHALL 1..* MeasureReport language, left OperationDefinition.comment saying the operation returned a MeasureReport resource directly, and did not update the still-listed retired Measure-evaluate-measure OperationDefinition.
additional_context: FHIR-37571 created the new Measure/$evaluate operation and marked Measure/$evaluate-measure retired; FHIR-50486 confirms the old operation is deprecated rather than removed. source/fhir.ini keeps Measure active and source/measure/list-Measure-operations.xml references both OperationDefinitions, so both source files are in current build scope. The FHIR-50487/FHIR-50484-family work added the Bundle-organization guidance that FHIR-51487 wanted linked, and the cited Zulip thread confirms the old direct-resource response note is wrong for a 0..* return.
reconciliation: Updated source/measure/operationdefinition-Measure-evaluate.xml footer, OperationDefinition.comment, and return parameter documentation to use the applied Bundle-per-subject, 1..* MeasureReport, evaluated-resource, guidance-link, and Parameters-response wording. Applied the same clarification to source/measure/operationdefinition-Measure-evaluate-measure.xml because that retired alias remains part of the active Measure operations list and still contained the stale wording.
